```plato

//==
// # Ellipses and superellipses
//
// The rotated conic regions: the ellipse proper and the Lame superellipse that
// interpolates between the diamond, the ellipse and the rectangle as its exponent
// grows. Both store a centre, a semi-axis pair, and a rotation about that centre.

// An ellipse region with semi-axis lengths SemiAxes (a along local X, b along
// local Y), rotated by Rotation about Center. A circle when a equals b.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellipse)
type Ellipse
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D
{
    Center: Point2D;
    SemiAxes: Number2;
    Rotation: Angle;
}
```
